message: サバイバル×リサイクル

name: Synn
message: 「Hah... hah...」
Why am I suddenly so exhausted.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I grew up downtown, so whenever I see a handcart, I just can't help wanting to ride it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It was kind of wobbly and scary, but it's fun\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, you're not children anymore...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You were looking at us pretty enviously though」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I was not...\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Senpai was sucking her thumb in envy too, though」

name: Ria
message: 「Eeeh!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Surely you aren't going to say your thumb just tasted delicious?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I wasn't envious at all! I'm everyone's senpai, after all!」

name: Misa
message: 「As expected of you, Sister...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Holding back all the time isn't good for your health. It's written that stress shortens your lifespan」

name: Ria
message: 「That sounds serious. Then I'll have him give me a ride on the way back」

name: Synn
message: 「Give me a break」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It'll surely be tough since Senpai is heavy~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh... Lolo-chan... wh-what a terrifying thing to say...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, the size of her boobs is completely different from ours, isn't it?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's way too rude, Lolotte-san!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it? Apparently boobs are called a barometer of a woman's charm. I'm truly envious」

name: Synn
message: 「Reading that guidebook again?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. However, it also says that having big boobs makes them heavy and hard to deal with」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In short, Lolo-chan wants to be like Ria-senpai」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. She's my role model ♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Geez, just say that from the start. Words like 'heavy' or 'fat' are totally taboo when talking to a girl」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so! How rude of me」

name: Ria
message: 「N-No, it's fine, aha, ahaha...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if they're heavy, Ria-chan is still the absolute best!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Piston!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「M-More importantly, we're supposed to be collecting unwanted items!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh no, that's right!」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see, where should we start first?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, over there, over there!」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Over there!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, where?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ponpoko... is that a toy shop?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Tame-san's place」

name: Misa
message: 「Tame-san... is he an acquaintance of yours?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Old man Tamekage. Commonly known as Tame-san's toy shop, 'Ponpoko'」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hey, welcome! --Wait, what the heck. It's just you again, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「That's harsh, Tame-san. I mean, sure, I don't have any money on me, but still」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're here on Student Council business. We came to collect unwanted items to sell at a bazaar」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Coming here for that means you've got a good eye」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because the sign clearly says 'Recycle'!」

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be that they recycle toys here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Tame-san also runs a thrift shop, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Which is why Synn, being the junk lover he is, is a regular here」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Collecting unwanted items to reuse them is just so wonderful~♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, if a thrift shop just hands over its secondhand goods, wouldn't that put them out of business?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha. Maybe so」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is no laughing matter. We cannot force hardship upon those who cooperate with us」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine, really. Look, check out the price tag」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zero... yen? It's completely free!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nowadays it even costs money just to throw away trash, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「And that's what Tame-san took advantage of」

name: Misa
message: 「I see. Since he gets them for free, he sells them for free」

name: Tame-san
message: 「And if folks buy some toys while they're at it, then everybody wins」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh--. I had no idea a shop like this existed--」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka and I got a lot of help from him last year too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm. In that case, since we'll need heaps and heaps more this year--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Excuse meeee!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, looks like she's jumping right into negotiations」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Can I... try playing with this!?」

name: Synn
message: 「*Thud*」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Ah, this one's quite the wild bronco, though... Are you sure about that, little lady?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's just what I want!」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Hahaha, I like your spirit. Go right ahead and play for a full 30 minutes until your hips give out」
As soon as Lolotte straddled the shady machine, Tame-san flipped the switch.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawawawawawa」
It was a piece of exercise equipment called the "Rodeo CAMP 3."

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauuuuuuu」
Shaking up and down, side to side, and tracing figure-eights, Lolotte's entire body bounced wildly atop the machine.
Gulp.
She might not be as big as Senpai, but Lolotte definitely has enough up top to bounce around nicely.
M-My heart's starting to race a little.
No, no! I shouldn't be thinking perverted thoughts...

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I-I-I can't take any more~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Watch out!」
The instant she nearly got bucked off, I caught Lolotte in my arms.
Her soft, fluffy body came fluttering right into my embrace.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haa... haa...」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you okay?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I came in just three minutes... My head is spinning, Mr. President...」
Letting out hot, steamy breaths, Lolotte wrapped her arms around my neck and clung to me.
Our skin pressed relentlessly close together. H-How bold can she get...?!
Bad, bad, if anyone else sees us like this--

name: Misa
message: 「This ornament is so lovely and stylish--are you sure it's okay for me to take it for free!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Aah~~ this New Year's tea ceremony set. I really want it, maybe I'll secretly buy it at the bazaar」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tame-saaan! What's supposed to be 'fully automatic' about this fully automatic DVD player?! I bet you got stuck with a dud!」
Phew... Everyone seems completely absorbed in rummaging through the junk.
Even so, I can't just stand here locked in an embrace with Lolotte forever.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz, zzz」
She's asleep...

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte. Hey, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Flinch*!! Oh, I'm so sorry. It just felt so good I couldn't help myself」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?! F-Felt so good...\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This really isn't the time to be dozing off in a place like this. Hup」
She hopped down lightly onto her feet.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much, Mr. President」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... no, not at all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, Mr. Toy Shop Owner. May we borrow some of your unwanted items for the Charity Bazaar?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Yeah, take whatever you want, you thieves!」
So generous, as always.

name: Tame-san
message: 「Just make sure you properly dispose of anything that doesn't sell, got it?」
So shrewd, as always.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's pick out things that look like they'll sell so we don't get stuck with leftover stock」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So opportunistic, as always」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Things that look like they'll sell, right? This 'Super Arabian Washing Machine' looks quite interesting!!」

name: Misa
message: 「How are you even supposed to use that...」

name: Synn
message: 「'Fuel-Efficient Thread Clippers,' huh... I'm getting a real bargain vibe from this」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They don't need fuel in the first place!! That's way too dangerous!!」

name: Ria
message: 「First... this one, and this one. Come, come, draw near--just kidding」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A 'Cushion PC'?! I-Is this one of those personal computers that are all the rage right now?!」

name: Synn
message: 「'Reversible Headphones,' huh... With these, I might be able to enjoy some deep, heavy sound」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look, that's all well and good, but... no matter how you look at it, this is all dead stock\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmm... I can't let myself lose either!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even you, Misa?! In that case, I'm hunting for gag material too!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun-this is a contest!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoever gets the biggest laugh wins, right?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, hey, stop fooling around」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A playful spirit is important too, but please take this a little more seriously」

name: Ria
message: 「Aah~. Everything here is full of things I want. Oh well, toss 'em all in!」

name: Synn
message: 「It says 'Reusable All-Purpose Eraser'! Now this is terrifying!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「'Plushie-Style Bicycle'... How adorable\s04」

name: Girl
message: 「Whoa! Super-rare 'Plushie-Style Bicycle' spotted!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, no you don't. We had our eyes on that first」

name: Girl
message: 「At a bargain like this, it's 'All-You-Can-Eat-or-DIE!' beef bowls anytime」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. This is an important item we're putting in the bazaar」

name: Girl
message: 「Mister! Gimme this!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Listen to what people are saying!!」

name: Girl
message: 「What're you talking about, for a stupid angel」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wha--! How dreadful!」

name: Girl
message: 「Listen up. This thing is guaranteed to sell out even on Demon World Mail-Order!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's not a valid excuse!」

name: Girl
message: 「Secured!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I told you, no!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now. Something like that isn't a big deal, is it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President...」

name: Girl
message: 「Hmph. I take it you're basically this girl's Oyabin, big bro?」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oyabin...?」

name: Girl
message: 「When the Oyabin doesn't keep things tight, the minions turn out pathetic!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-Pathetic?!」

name: Girl
message: 「Unlike her, I'm Super Minion Unit 1, super-trusted by my Oyabin」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte isn't a minion, she's a fellow member of the Student Council」

name: Girl
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-What is it? Staring at someone like that...」

name: Girl
message: 「No way!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... now, now. We got them shared with us for free too, so just one is totally fine, right?\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...That is true. With a heart wider than the surface area of a sheet of origami, I shall forgive you.」

name: Girl
message: 「Yay, thank youuu!」
The girl lunged at Lolotte.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyaa」

name: Girl
message: 「Gah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aaaah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What, what!? What happened, what happened?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「T-Tontoro is... My Tontoro is~~~」

name: Synn
message: 「A huge pile of 500-yen coins!? S-So much money... aah~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn! Calm down, get a hold of yourself!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh no, we have to pick them up quickly\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「Mr. Piggy has been reduced to a dreadful state...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Euuh...」

name: Girl
message: 「Hey, it's not my fault! It's your fault for not holding onto it properly!」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me, young lady. Isn't that an awful way to talk?」

name: Sally
message: 「What's with that infuriating way of addressing me?! I have a proper cute name, 'Sally-chan,' you know!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally-chan. I know you didn't mean to, but Lolotte-chan is really sad, so...」

name: Sally
message: 「I-I-I-I don't care one bit about that!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, she was holding onto it like it was her most prized possession, saying how precious it was.」

name: Sally
message: 「Uuuh~~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「One piece of Tontoro, two pieces, three pieces...」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go, Lolotte-chan. For now, here's the money」

name: Lolotte
message: 「One coin, two coins, three coins」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah--!! No, no, this is no time to be passing out!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We've already cleaned up the 500-yen coins, so it's fine.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn. Lolotte is in a pretty bad state right now...」

name: Misa
message: 「At this rate, she might never recover.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hrmmm... Even if it was an accident, it's still a fact that you broke Lolotte's piggy bank...」

name: Sally
message: 「Ugh!」

name: Synn
message: 「I think if you apologize, it'll at least cheer Lolotte up a bit, you know?」

name: Sally
message: 「Uh, um... well... s-s-s-s, sor... sor--」

name: Sally
message: 「Uggggh... No, I won't do it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why not!?」

name: Sally
message: 「You're just gonna pulverize my delicate maiden heart like that, and then when I'm all dizzy and weak, you're all gonna gang up and bully me, aren't you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's what was going on!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmph. I don't trust any of you. The only ones I can trust are the Boss and his merry gang!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gang?」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh! Speak of the devil, here they come!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, that's...!」

name: Sally
message: 「Mochimochi!」

name: Sally
message: 「Jangara!」

name: Sally
message: 「Tinun!」

name: Sally
message: 「All together now--」

name: Sally
message: 「Delicious Food Squad♪」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Demons!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my. They're the ones who were eating meat buns at the Five-Star Restaurant earlier」

name: Synn
message: 「You remember them well, even though they all look pretty much the same」

name: Sally
message: 「Aaah! Could it be, the 'Student Council' Mochimochi was talking about is......」

name: Synn
message: 「Us?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Probably. Wait, demons actually have names?」

name: Sally
message: 「Running into you here is your bad luck! Now is the time to avenge my comrades' humiliation!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Humiliation? All we did was warn them」

name: Sally
message: 「Eh, really? Wawah! I just talked all big and tough, what do I do!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Though, maybe we punished them just a biiit too much」

name: Sally
message: 「Aha, I knew it!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, it's your guys' fault, isn't it. Eating meat buns when you didn't even have any money」

name: Sally
message: 「Meat buns? What are you talking about?」

name: Misa
message: 「You were eating them earlier, weren't you. Looking like you were really enjoying them」

name: Sally
message: 「I didn't eat any!」

name: Sally
message: 「Aah, they ran away! Hey, what's going on here!? Explain yourselves properlyyy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa! And straight into betrayal」

name: Ria
message: 「I feel a little bad for her\s02」

name: Sally
message: 「Heyyy!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Little imp. Fighting among comrades is no good, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte!」

name: Sally
message: 「Kyaa! I'm not a little imp! I'm Sally! The demon girl who makes even crying kids dance\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The people of old once said: Be fruitful and multiply with your neighbors」

name: Ria
message: 「Love one another, right\s01」

name: Sally
message: 「You say 'neighbor,' but the guy right next to you is that dude! Why don't you multiply and have kids with him~?」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Me and Lolotte...

name: Synn
message: Hmph!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「All things with form will break someday. Forget about Tontoro.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay, thanks~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, fighting with your close friends is not good.」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, they ate a meat bun behind my back!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, just smile. Let's forgive them. Right, everyone?」
Why isn't anyone making eye contact with Lolotte?!

name: Sally
message: 「Even if you say that, I'm neeever forgiving what can't be forgiven!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If that's all it takes, then your little imp organization isn't much to speak of.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hoho! Don't underestimate the unity of my 'Delicious Food Squad♪'!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh, did they already make up?」

name: Ria
message: 「Feels like the conversation is wrapping up in a weird direction...」

name: Misa
message: 「For now, let's just accept our fate.」

name: Sally
message: 「Come on! Fight us fair and square, Student Council!」

name: Synn
message: 「Talk about a sudden turn of events!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Very well. Let us settle once and for all... which side gets along better!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Safety!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「C-Certainty?」

name: Everyone
message: 「Leave your sparkling school life to the Ryuusei Crusaders!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... High yield.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady. Humble though my abilities may be, I, Riesling Tooyama, shall lend my aid.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」
